headline: Reserve Bank of Australia signals potential rate hike on inflation
summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia warned that third-quarter underlying inflation is tracking significantly higher than central bank targets.
why: Higher inflation readings frequently force central banks to raise interest rates, impacting consumer borrowing costs, mortgage rates, and equity valuations.
